changelog:
v2.3.3 — Audio Codec Fix + Memory Optimization

• Streams with unsupported audio (AC3/Dolby Digital) now play video without audio instead of crashing
• Shows 'Unsupported codec' indicator when audio can't be decoded
• Reduced buffer sizes on low-RAM devices to prevent out-of-memory crashes
• Fixes playback failures on older Fire TV Sticks with limited memory
